newsitem.title: UK: Airtours up on talk of 250 mln stg buy plan.
newsitem.headline: Airtours up on talk of 250 mln stg buy plan.

text.p: Shares in British package holiday company Airtours were almost two percent higher in early Thursday trading after the Independent newspaper reported that it was set to go on a 250 million stg spending spree.
The shares were up 13p to 727-1/2p at 0850 GMT, making the stock the second largest net gainer in London.
The Independent said one early deal would be the acquisition of Canadian tour operator Signature, currently owned by UK rival First Choice, worth roughly 50 million stg.
On Wednesday the company announced a 46.1 percent jump in pre-tax profits for the year to 86.8 million stg.
